subject: science
passage: The marine bacterium Vibrio fischeri is capable of producing light, yet a lone cell drifting in open water stays dark. Each cell continually releases a small signaling molecule into its surroundings, and only when the bacteria are densely crowded, as they are inside the light organ of the Hawaiian bobtail squid, does that molecule accumulate enough to switch on the genes for light production. The bacteria, in other words, do not glow simply because they are able to; they ______ their glow, producing it only when enough cells are present for the light to be bright enough to matter.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

explanation.why: The text contrasts merely being able to glow with glowing "only when enough cells are present." The semicolon sets up a correction: the bacteria actively control when the light is made. The blank needs a verb meaning "control or adjust according to conditions."
explanation.A: Incorrect. Nothing in the text suggests the bacteria copy another organism's light; the point is that they control their own.
explanation.B: Correct. To regulate something is to control when and how much of it happens, which matches cells that switch on light production only at high density.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The bacteria may inherit the ability to glow, but the text says they "do not glow simply because they are able to"; the blank must describe how they control the glow, not where the ability came from.
explanation.D: Incorrect. "Relinquish" means give up; the bacteria do produce light when crowded, so they do not give it up.
